parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: This is the toggle or actuator part of the wall switch, made of durable plastic. It is small and protrudes from the base body.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the user interface for turning the electrical circuit on or off by toggling or pressing.
parts.Movement_description: It moves rotationally or linearly depending on the switch design, allowing electrical contact to open or close.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base plate or housing of the wall switch, made of rigid plastic. It provides structural support and mounting points.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the internal electrical components and provides a surface for mounting the switch to the wall.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and fixed to the wall or electrical box, providing stability for the switch mechanism.
